items.title: ‘Remarkable luck’: wreck of first Australian-built warship discovered exactly 128 years after sinking
items.summary: HMCS Spitfire was commissioned by colonial government to protect against Russian warships during the Crimean war The wreck of Australia’s first locally built warship has been discovered 128 years after sinking off the coast of far north Queensland.

items.title: ICJ to rule on Rohingya genocide case against Myanmar: What’s at stake?
items.summary: World court to issue key verdict in its first genocide ruling in more than a decade.

items.title: Could measles and midterms bring down Maha? – podcast
items.summary: This week the US lost its measles elimination status, an official recognition that the infectious disease is endemic in the country after being eliminated for 26 years.
